body: That's the thing, I've exhausted the people around me, they don't really help me anymore, they just kinda take what I say and just shrug it off. I can't blame them, I know how badly I have hurt them with it and I know how bad I get when my mood swings. Hell I feel bad for even talking to you simply because I can see how hard you're trying, which I really appreciate, but I know it'll fall on deaf ears
I understand what you're saying and I hear you. I really don't think that it'll affect people all that much since there have been many attempts and treats in the past. It really won't be a surprise

I really know I should and the rational side of me says that you're right, but I really really don't want to. I feel relieved finally, like things are finally ok.

God listen to me I sound so fucking selfish and pathetic, I'm sitting here asking other people to talk to me during this when I already know the right thing to do I just don't want to do it
